title: Self-supervised Graph Learning for Recommendation
grouping: Two horizontal rows separated by a double horizontal rule: the upper row is the main supervised task, the lower row the added self-supervised branch. In the lower row the input graph splits into two parallel sub-rows, each with an augmentation panel containing three variants (ED, ND, RW) separated by vertical dashed lines, labelled ED1/ND1/RW1 and ED2/ND2/RW2. Bold labels sit under each stage (Graph Structure, GCN Model, Representation).
shapes_depth: The input is a small bipartite graph thumbnail in a square black frame: user nodes as yellow-outlined circles in a left column, item nodes as blue-outlined circles at right, thin black edges. Augmented copies keep the same layout; dropped edges are dashed lines and dropped nodes dashed circles. The GCN model is a small framed icon of a node aggregating from neighbours on curved yellow and grey bands. Representations are framed grids of coloured cells (yellow, blue, green, orange columns). Losses are open circles labelled L_main and L_ssl. Thin black arrows, flat, no shadows.
proposed_highlight: The proposed self-supervised branch takes the whole lower half and is the only part that branches; it ends in its own loss L_ssl, while the upper row is a single plain line to L_main. No colour is reserved for it.
lesson: Stack the main task as a thin top row and the added self-supervised branch below it, both starting from the same small bipartite graph thumbnail, and draw each augmented view as a copy of that graph with the dropped edges and nodes dashed.
notes: Venue and year from the PDF's first page (SIGIR '21). Crop is small (column figure); details checked on a 400 dpi re-crop of the same figure.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)

insights.structure: Two rows separated by a double horizontal rule: the main supervised path on top (graph, GCN model, representation, L_main) and the self-supervised path below, where the graph splits into two parallel sub-rows, each with an augmentation panel of three variants ED, ND, RW divided by dashed vertical lines.
insights.data: The user-item graph is a small bipartite thumbnail (yellow user circles left, blue item circles right) whose augmented copies show dropped edges as dashed lines and dropped nodes as dashed circles; representations are vertical stacks of small coloured cell columns.
insights.emphasis: Repeating the same GCN icon and representation grid in both rows makes the added SSL branch read as a copy with augmentation, and the representation grids differ in colour between the two views.
insights.flow: Left to right in each row along thin black lines; the two lower sub-rows merge by right-angle lines into one circle for L_ssl.
insights.avoid: The top row has a long empty arrow from Graph Structure to the GCN icon and the GCN icons are tiny and illegible; drop the dead space and use a legible model glyph.

arrangement.units: two horizontal lanes split by a double rule; each stage is a small square-framed thumbnail with a bold label below
arrangement.inputs_as: a bipartite user-item graph thumbnail in a square frame
arrangement.shared: the GCN model icon is repeated in all three paths (shared encoder)
